readings.section: The Architecture of the Divine Dwelling
readings.title: Gathering the Elements for the Set-apart Place
readings.subtitle: The Material Blueprint of the Heavenly Pattern
readings.text: [Exodus 25:1] And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke to Mosheh, saying, [2] <dq>“Speak to the children of Yisra’ěl, that they take up a contribution for <dn>Me</dn>. From everyone whose heart moves him you shall take up <dn>My</dn> contribution.</dq> [3] <dq>“And this is the contribution which you take up from them: gold, and silver, and bronze,</dq> [4] <dq>and blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,</dq> [5] <dq>and rams’ skins dyed red, and fine leather, and acacia wood,</dq> [6] <dq>oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,</dq> [7] <dq>shoham stones, and stones to be set in the shoulder garment and in the breastplate.</dq> [8] <dq>“And they shall make <dn>Me</dn> <dn>את</dn> a Set-apart Place, and <dn>I</dn> shall dwell in their midst.</dq> [9] <dq>“According to all that <dn>I</dn> show you – <dn>את</dn> the pattern of the Dwelling Place and <dn>את</dn> the pattern of all its furnishings – make it exactly so.</dq>

readings.section: The Architecture of the Divine Dwelling
readings.title: The Ark of the Witness
readings.subtitle: The Epicenter of Covenant and Atonement
readings.text: [Exodus 25:10] <dq>“And they shall make <dn>את</dn> an ark of acacia wood two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall overlay <dn>את</dn> it with clean gold, inside and outside you shall overlay it. And you shall make on it a moulding of gold all around.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four corners, two rings on one side, and two rings on the other side.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold,</dq> [14] <dq>and shall put <dn>את</dn> the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to lift up <dn>את</dn> the ark by them.</dq> [15] <dq>“The poles are in the rings of the ark, they are not taken from it.</dq> [16] <dq>“And into the ark you shall put <dn>את</dn> the Witness which <dn>I</dn> give you.</dq> [17] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a lid of atonement of clean gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> two keruḇim of gold, make them of beaten work, at the two ends of the lid of atonement.</dq> [19] <dq>“And make <dn>את</dn> one keruḇ at one end, and <dn>את</dn> the other keruḇ at the other end. Make <dn>את</dn> the keruḇim from the lid of atonement, at its two ends.</dq> [20] <dq>“And the keruḇim shall be spreading out their wings above, covering <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement with their wings, with their faces toward each other, the faces of the keruḇim turned toward the lid of atonement.</dq> [21] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement on top of the ark, and put into the ark <dn>את</dn> the Witness which <dn>I</dn> give you.</dq> [22] <dq>“And <dn>I</dn> shall meet with you there, and from above the lid of atonement, from between the two keruḇim which are on the ark of the Witness, <dn>I</dn> shall speak to you all that which <dn>I</dn> command you concerning the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq>

readings.section: The Architecture of the Divine Dwelling
readings.title: The Table of Continual Presence
readings.subtitle: The Bread of the Mashiach's Provision
readings.text: [Exodus 25:23] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.</dq> [24] <dq>“And you shall overlay <dn>את</dn> it with clean gold, and shall make a moulding of gold all around,</dq> [25] <dq>and shall make for it a rim of a handbreadth all around, and shall make a gold moulding for the rim all around.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put <dn>את</dn> the rings on the four corners that are at its four legs.</dq> [27] <dq>“The rings are close to the rim, as holders for the poles to lift the table.</dq> [28] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, and the table shall be lifted with them.</dq> [29] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> its dishes, and <dn>את</dn> its ladles, and <dn>את</dn> its jars, and <dn>את</dn> its bowls for pouring. Make them of clean gold.</dq> [30] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the showbread on the table before <dn>Me</dn>, continually.</dq>

readings.section: The Architecture of the Divine Dwelling
readings.title: The Lampstand of Clean Gold
readings.subtitle: The Sevenfold Light of the Ruach
readings.text: [Exodus 25:31] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a lampstand of clean gold – the lampstand is made of beaten work. Its base and its shaft, its cups, its ornamental knobs and blossoms are from it,</dq> [32] <dq>and six branches shall come out of its sides: three branches of the lampstand out of one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side;</dq> [33] <dq>three cups made like almond flowers on one branch, with ornamental knob and blossom, and three cups made like almond flowers on the other branch, with ornamental knob and blossom – so for the six branches coming out of the lampstand.</dq> [34] <dq>“And on the lampstand itself are four cups made like almond flowers, with ornamental knob and blossom,</dq> [35] <dq>and a knob under the first two branches of the same, and a knob under the second two branches of the same, and a knob under the third two branches of the same, according to the six branches coming out of the lampstand.</dq> [36] <dq>“Their knobs and their branches are of the same – all of it one beaten work of clean gold.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> seven lamps for it, and they shall mount its lamps so that they give light in front of it.</dq> [38] <dq>“And its snuffers and their trays are of clean gold.</dq> [39] <dq>“It is made of a talent of clean gold, with all these utensils.</dq> [40] <dq>“So see, and do according to the pattern which was shown to you on the mountain.</dq>

readings.title: The Ten Woven Curtains
readings.subtitle: Keruḇim and the Unified Dwelling Place
readings.text: [Exodus 26:1] <dq>“And make <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place with ten curtains of fine woven linen and blue and purple and scarlet material. Make them, with keruḇim, the work of a skilled workman.</dq> [2] <dq>“The length of each curtain is twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits, all the curtains having one measure.</dq> [3] <dq>“Five curtains are joined to each other, and five curtains are joined to each other.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of the end curtain on one set, and do the same on the edge of the end curtain of the second set.</dq> [5] <dq>“Make fifty loops in the one curtain and make fifty loops on the edge of the end curtain of the second set, the loops being opposite to each other.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall make fifty hooks of gold, and shall join <dn>את</dn> the curtains together with the hooks, and the Dwelling Place shall be one.</dq>

readings.title: The Goats' Hair and Ram Skins
readings.subtitle: Protective Layers of the Tent
readings.text: [Exodus 26:7] <dq>“And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair, for a tent over the Dwelling Place, make eleven curtains.</dq> [8] <dq>“The length of each curtain is thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits, one measure to the eleven curtains.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall join <dn>את</dn> the five curtains by themselves, and <dn>את</dn> the six curtains by themselves, and you shall double over <dn>את</dn> the six curtains at the front of the Tent.</dq> [10] <dq>“And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain of the second set.</dq> [11] <dq>“And you shall make fifty bronze hooks, and put <dn>את</dn> the hooks into the loops, and join <dn>את</dn> the tent together, and it shall be one.</dq> [12] <dq>“And the overlapping part of the rest of the curtains of the Tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [13] <dq>“And a cubit on one side and a cubit on the other side, of what remains of the length of the curtains of the Tent, is to hang over the sides of the Dwelling Place, on this side and on that side, to cover it.</dq> [14] <dq>“And you shall make a covering of ram skins dyed red for the Tent, and a covering of fine leather above that.</dq>

readings.title: Acacia Boards and Silver Sockets
readings.subtitle: The Structural Foundation of Redemption
readings.text: [Exodus 26:15] <dq>“And for the Dwelling Place you shall make <dn>את</dn> the boards of acacia wood, standing up.</dq> [16] <dq>“Ten cubits is the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board,</dq> [17] <dq>two tenons in each board for binding one to another. Do the same for all the boards of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [18] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the boards for the Dwelling Place, twenty boards for the south side,</dq> [19] <dq>and make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under each of the boards for its two tenons.</dq> [20] <dq>“And for the second side of the Dwelling Place, on the north side, twenty boards,</dq> [21] <dq>and their forty sockets of silver, two sockets under each of the boards.</dq> [22] <dq>“And for the extreme parts of the Dwelling Place, westward, make six boards,</dq> [23] <dq>and make two boards for the two back corners of the Dwelling Place.</dq> [24] <dq>“And they are double beneath and similarly they are complete to the top, to the one ring. So it is for both of them, they are for the two corners.</dq> [25] <dq>“And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets – two sockets under the one board, and two sockets under the other board.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make bars of acacia wood, five for the boards on one side of the Dwelling Place,</dq> [27] <dq>and five bars for the boards on the other side of the Dwelling Place, and five bars for the boards of the side of the Dwelling Place, for the extreme parts westward,</dq> [28] <dq>with the middle bar in the midst of the boards, going through from end to end.</dq> [29] <dq>“And overlay <dn>את</dn> the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold as holders for the bars, and overlay <dn>את</dn> the bars with gold.</dq> [30] <dq>“And you shall raise up <dn>את</dn> the Dwelling Place according to its pattern which you were shown on the mountain.</dq>

readings.title: Guarding the Most Set-apart Place
readings.subtitle: The Boundary of the Divine Presence
readings.text: [Exodus 26:31] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a veil of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, the work of a skilled workman, made with keruḇim.</dq> [32] <dq>“And you shall put it on the four columns of acacia wood overlaid with gold, their hooks of gold, upon four sockets of silver.</dq> [33] <dq>“And you shall hang <dn>את</dn> the veil from the hooks, and shall bring <dn>את</dn> the ark of the Witness there, behind the veil. And the veil shall make a separation for you between the Set-apart and the Most Set-apart Place.</dq> [34] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the lid of atonement upon the ark of the Witness in the Most Set-apart Place.</dq> [35] <dq>“And you shall set <dn>את</dn> the table outside the veil, and <dn>את</dn> the lampstand opposite the table on the side of the Dwelling Place toward the south, and put <dn>את</dn> the table on the north side.</dq> [36] <dq>“And you shall make a covering for the door of the Tent, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall make for the covering five columns of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, their hooks of gold, and you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.</dq>

readings.title: The Bronze Slaughter-Place
readings.subtitle: The Crucible of Righteous Atonement
readings.text: [Exodus 27:1] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a slaughter-place of acacia wood, five cubits long and five cubits wide – the slaughter-place is square – and its height three cubits.</dq> [2] <dq>“And you shall make its horns on its four corners, its horns are of the same. And you shall overlay it with bronze.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you shall make its pots to receive its ashes, and its shovels and its basins and its forks and its fire holders. Make all its utensils of bronze.</dq> [4] <dq>“And you shall make a grating for it, a bronze network, and shall make on the network four bronze rings at its four corners,</dq> [5] <dq>and shall put it under the rim of the slaughter-place beneath, so that the network is halfway up the slaughter-place.</dq> [6] <dq>“And you shall make poles for the slaughter-place, poles of acacia wood, and shall overlay them with bronze.</dq> [7] <dq>“And the poles shall be put in the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the slaughter-place for lifting it.</dq> [8] <dq>“Make it hollow with boards. As it was shown to you on the mountain, so they are to make it.</dq>

readings.title: The Linen Screens of the Courtyard
readings.subtitle: Establishing the Boundaries of the Set-apart Ground
readings.text: [Exodus 27:9] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the courtyard of the Dwelling Place: for the south side screens for the courtyard made of fine woven linen, one hundred cubits long for one side,</dq> [10] <dq>and its twenty columns and their twenty sockets of bronze, the hooks of the columns and their bands of silver,</dq> [11] <dq>and so for the north side in length, screens one hundred cubits long, with its twenty columns and their twenty sockets of bronze, and the hooks of the columns and their bands of silver.</dq> [12] <dq>“And the width of the courtyard on the west side screens of fifty cubits, with their ten columns and their ten sockets.</dq> [13] <dq>“And the width of the courtyard on the east side fifty cubits.</dq> [14] <dq>“And the screens on one side of the gate fifteen cubits, with their three columns and their three sockets.</dq> [15] <dq>“And on the other side screens of fifteen cubits, with their three columns and their three sockets.</dq> [16] <dq>“And for the gate of the courtyard a covering twenty cubits long, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, made by a weaver – four columns and four sockets.</dq> [17] <dq>“All the columns around the courtyard have bands of silver, their hooks silver and their sockets bronze.</dq> [18] <dq>“The length of the courtyard is one hundred cubits, and the width fifty by fifty, and the height five cubits, woven of fine linen thread, and its sockets of bronze.</dq> [19] <dq>“All the utensils of the Dwelling Place for all its service, all its pegs, and all the pegs of the courtyard, are bronze.</dq>

readings.title: The Clear Oil of Pressed Olives
readings.subtitle: Illuminating the Witness Before YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Exodus 27:20] <dq>“And you, you are to command the children of Yisra’ěl to bring you clear oil of pressed olives for the light, to cause the lamp to burn continually.</dq> [21] <dq>“In the Tent of Appointment, outside the veil which is before the Witness, Aharon and his sons are to tend it from evening until morning before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – a law forever to their generations, from the children of Yisra’ěl.</dq>

readings.title: Set-apart Garments for Esteem
readings.subtitle: Preparing the Intercessors of Yisra’ěl
readings.text: [Exodus 28:1] <dq>“And you, bring near <dn>את</dn> Aharon your brother and his sons with him, from among the children of Yisra’ěl, for serving as priest to <dn>Me</dn>: Aharon, Naḏaḇ and Aḇihu, El‛azar and Ithamar, the sons of Aharon.</dq> [2] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> set-apart garments for Aharon your brother, for esteem and for comeliness.</dq> [3] <dq>“And you, speak to all the wise of heart, whom <dn>I</dn> have filled with a spirit of wisdom, and they shall make <dn>את</dn> the garments of Aharon, to set him apart, for him to serve as priest to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [4] <dq>“And these are the garments which they make: a breastplate, a shoulder garment, a robe, an embroidered long shirt, a turban, and a girdle. And they shall make <dn>את</dn> set-apart garments for Aharon your brother and his sons, for him to serve as priest to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [5] <dq>“And they shall take <dn>את</dn> the gold, and <dn>את</dn> the blue and <dn>את</dn> the purple and <dn>את</dn> the scarlet material, and <dn>את</dn> the fine linen,</dq>

readings.title: Bearing the Weight of the Tribes
readings.subtitle: Stones of Remembrance Before YeHoVaH
readings.text: [Exodus 28:6] <dq>and shall make <dn>את</dn> the shoulder garment of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen, the work of a skilled workman.</dq> [7] <dq>“It is to have two shoulder pieces joined at its two edges, and so it is joined together.</dq> [8] <dq>“And the embroidered band of the shoulder garment, which is on it, is of the same workmanship, made of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen.</dq> [9] <dq>“And you shall take <dn>את</dn> two shoham stones and engrave on them <dn>את</dn> the names of the sons of Yisra’ěl,</dq> [10] <dq>six of their names on one stone, and <dn>את</dn> the remaining six names on the other stone, according to their birth.</dq> [11] <dq>“With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, engrave <dn>את</dn> the two stones with the names of the sons of Yisra’ěl. Set them in settings of gold.</dq> [12] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the two stones on the shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment as stones of remembrance for the sons of Yisra’ěl. And Aharon shall bear their names before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> on his two shoulders, for a remembrance.</dq> [13] <dq>“And you shall make settings of gold,</dq> [14] <dq>and two chains of clean gold like braided cords, and fasten <dn>את</dn> the braided chains to the settings.</dq>

readings.title: The Twelve Foundation Stones
readings.subtitle: Engraved Names of the Family of Yisra’ěl
readings.text: [Exodus 28:15] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a breastplate of right-ruling, a work of a skilled workman, like the work of the shoulder garment. Make it of gold, of blue and purple and scarlet material, and fine woven linen.</dq> [16] <dq>“It is square, doubled, a span its length, and a span its width.</dq> [17] <dq>“And you shall put settings of stones in it, four rows of stones: The first row is a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald;</dq> [18] <dq>and the second row is a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;</dq> [19] <dq>and the third row is a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;</dq> [20] <dq>and the fourth row is a beryl, and a shoham, and a jasper. They are set in gold settings.</dq> [21] <dq>“And the stones are according to the names of the sons of Yisra’ěl, twelve according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, each one with its own name, for the twelve tribes.</dq>

readings.title: The Urim and Tummim
readings.subtitle: Securing the Right-Ruling Over the Heart
readings.text: [Exodus 28:22] <dq>“And you shall make braided chains of corded work for the breastplate at the end, of clean gold.</dq> [23] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold for the breastplate, and shall put <dn>את</dn> the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.</dq> [24] <dq>“And you shall put <dn>את</dn> the two cords of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate,</dq> [25] <dq>and <dn>את</dn> the other two ends of the two cords you fasten to the two settings, and put them on the shoulder pieces of the shoulder garment in the front.</dq> [26] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold, and shall put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on the edge of it, which is on the inner side of the shoulder garment.</dq> [27] <dq>“And you shall make two rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder pieces, underneath the shoulder garment, on the front of it, close to the seam above the embroidered band of the shoulder garment,</dq> [28] <dq>and they bind <dn>את</dn> the breastplate by means of its rings to the rings of the shoulder garment, using a blue cord, so that it is above the embroidered band of the shoulder garment, so that the breastplate does not come loose from the shoulder garment.</dq> [29] <dq>“And Aharon shall bear <dn>את</dn> the names of the sons of Yisra’ěl on the breastplate of right-ruling over his heart, when he goes into the set-apart place, for a remembrance before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, continually.</dq> [30] <dq>“And into the breastplate of right-ruling you shall put <dn>את</dn> the Urim and <dn>את</dn> the Tummim, and they shall be on the heart of Aharon when he goes in before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. And Aharon shall bear <dn>את</dn> the right-ruling of the children of Yisra’ěl on his heart before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, continually.</dq>

readings.title: The Blue Robe and Golden Bells
readings.subtitle: The Sound of Intercession and Life
readings.text: [Exodus 28:31] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> the robe of the shoulder garment all of blue.</dq> [32] <dq>“And the opening for his head shall be in the middle of it, a woven binding all around its opening, like the opening in a scaled armour, so that it does not tear.</dq> [33] <dq>“And on its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet material, all around its hem, and bells of gold between them all around:</dq> [34] <dq>a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, on the hem of the robe all around.</dq> [35] <dq>“And it shall be upon Aharon to attend in, and its sound shall be heard when he goes into the set-apart place before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and when he comes out, so that he does not die.</dq>

readings.title: The Golden Plate of Set-apartness
readings.subtitle: Bearing the Guilt of the Set-apart Gifts
readings.text: [Exodus 28:36] <dq>“And you shall make <dn>את</dn> a plate of clean gold and engrave on it, like the engraving of a signet: SET-APARTNESS TO <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq> [37] <dq>“And you shall put it on a blue cord, and it shall be on the turban – it is to be on the front of the turban.</dq> [38] <dq>“And it shall be on the forehead of Aharon, and Aharon shall bear <dn>את</dn> the guilt of the set-apart gifts which the children of Yisra’ěl set apart in all their set-apart gifts. And it shall always be on his forehead, for acceptance for them before <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.</dq>

readings.title: Covering the Flesh for Service
readings.subtitle: The Law of Consecration for the Priesthood
readings.text: [Exodus 28:39] <dq>“And you shall weave <dn>את</dn> the long shirt of fine linen, and shall make <dn>את</dn> the turban of fine linen, and you shall make <dn>את</dn> the girdle of woven work.</dq> [40] <dq>“And make <dn>את</dn> long shirts for Aharon’s sons. And you shall make girdles for them, and you shall make turbans for them, for esteem and comeliness.</dq> [41] <dq>“And you shall put them on Aharon your brother and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and shall ordain them, and shall set them apart, and they shall serve as priests to <dn>Me</dn>.</dq> [42] <dq>“And make <dn>את</dn> linen trousers for them, to cover their nakedness, reaching from the waist to the thighs.</dq> [43] <dq>“And they shall be on Aharon and on his sons when they come into the Tent of Appointment, or when they come near the slaughter-place to attend in the Set-apart Place, so that they do not bear crookedness and die – a law forever to him, and to his seed after him.</dq>
